questions.question: Dr. MIKOU has a conflict with his assistant. Dr. YOUSSEF advises him to call on the union. What is the union's role in this type of conflict?
options: Play a mediating and advisory role
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union can play a mediating role in labor disputes.' MIKOU: 'So it helps me resolve the problem without falling out with my assistant.' YOUSSEF: 'Exactly, it's more professional!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF informs Dr. MIKOU of a case of illegal practice in their region. What is the union's position on illegal practice?
options: It supports it out of solidarity
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union actively fights illegal practice.' MIKOU: 'So it protects our profession.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, against charlatans who harm us!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU learns that a colleague is on trial. Dr. YOUSSEF explains that the union can accompany him. What assistance can the union provide?
options: Take over the defense instead of the dentist
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union provides legal advice and support.' MIKOU: 'So I'm not alone facing justice.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, and it's reassuring!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF mentions the fight against fake dentists. According to him, why does the union engage in this fight?
options: To protect patients and the profession
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The fight against fake dentists protects patients and the profession.' MIKOU: 'So it's a public health mission.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, MIKOU, you're starting to understand!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks how the union handles patient complaints. Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
options: It can accompany the dentist and advise
It always supports the patient against the dentist
It does not deal with complaints
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union can accompany the dentist and advise them on complaints.' MIKOU: 'So it protects me even against dissatisfied patients.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, without taking sides, respecting justice.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF explains that the union ensures professional ethics. According to him, why is ethics important for the union?
options: To improve the image of dentists
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Professional ethics improves the image of dentists.' MIKOU: 'So the union helps us be respected.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, public trust is essential!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU learns that a colleague has been struck off the Order. Dr. YOUSSEF tells him that the union can help. How can the union help a dentist who has been struck off?
options: By contesting the striking off before the courts
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union can contest the striking off before the courts.' MIKOU: 'So it doesn't abandon a colleague.' YOUSSEF: 'No, that's union solidarity!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF mentions disciplinary sanctions. According to him, can the union intervene in a disciplinary procedure?
options: Yes, it can accompany the dentist
Only if the dentist is innocent
No, that's exclusively the Order's role
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union can accompany the dentist in a disciplinary procedure.' MIKOU: 'So I'm not alone facing the Order.' YOUSSEF: 'Exactly, you have an ally!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks how the union reacts to new laws. Dr. YOUSSEF explains that the union:
options: Analyzes them and can propose amendments
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union analyzes laws and can propose amendments.' MIKOU: 'So it influences legislation.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, that's our role!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF explains that the union can help dentists who are victims of non-payment. What help is possible?
options: The union pays the unpaid amounts
The union advises on legal remedies
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union advises on legal remedies for non-payment.' MIKOU: 'So it helps me recover my money.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, it's financial protection!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU wonders about relations between unions and mutual insurance companies. Dr. YOUSSEF explains that the union:
options: Negotiates with mutual insurance companies for dentists
Leaves dentists to fend for themselves
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union negotiates with mutual insurance companies for dentists.' MIKOU: 'So it defends my interests with mutual insurance companies too.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, so you get good reimbursement!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF explains the concept of 'professional watch'. What is union professional watch?
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Professional watch follows news and laws to protect the profession.' MIKOU: 'So the union is always informed.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, to better defend you!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'What does the union do in a health crisis?' Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
options: It lets the authorities handle it
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'In a crisis, the union mobilizes and coordinates dentists.' MIKOU: 'So it guides us in times of crisis.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, to protect patients and the profession.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF explains the notion of 'union representativeness'. Why must a union be representative?
options: To be heard and to carry weight in negotiations
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'A representative union is heard and carries weight in negotiations.' MIKOU: 'So dentists need to join en masse.' YOUSSEF: 'Exactly, strength in numbers!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU learns that the union can contact the authorities. Which authorities can the union contact?
options: The courts and the Ministry of Health
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union can contact the courts and the Ministry of Health.' MIKOU: 'So it can make things happen.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, if needed!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF explains that the union can help dentists in initial training. What help is offered?
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union offers professional orientation advice.' MIKOU: 'So it guides future dentists.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, to avoid beginner mistakes!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks how the union manages conflicts with other health professions. Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
options: It negotiates and seeks common solutions
It lets the authorities handle it
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union negotiates and seeks common solutions.' MIKOU: 'So it wants peace between professions.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, for the good of patients!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF mentions archives and union memory. Why is it important to preserve union memory?
options: To draw inspiration and not repeat mistakes
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Union memory allows us to draw inspiration and not repeat mistakes.' MIKOU: 'So we learn from the past.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, to build a better future!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU wonders about the union's independence. According to the labor code, the union must be:
options: Independent of public authorities and employers
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union must be independent of public authorities and employers.' MIKOU: 'So it's free in its actions.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, to defend our interests without pressure!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF explains the union's role in preventing occupational risks. What does the union do in this area?
options: It informs and raises awareness among dentists
It delegates this role to the State
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union informs and raises awareness among dentists about occupational risks.' MIKOU: 'So it helps us protect ourselves.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, our health is important!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks how the union handles member complaints. Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
options: It analyzes them and provides responses
It forwards them to authorities without follow-up
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union analyzes complaints and provides responses.' MIKOU: 'So it takes care of its members.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, that's its primary mission!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF mentions the importance of union transparency. Why is transparency important?
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Transparency reassures, attracts, and avoids corruption.' MIKOU: 'So a transparent union is a reliable union.' YOUSSEF: 'Exactly, trust is earned!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks how the union positions itself regarding new technologies. Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
options: It follows them and supports dentists
It fights them to protect jobs
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union follows new technologies and supports dentists.' MIKOU: 'So it helps us evolve.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, to remain competitive!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF explains the concept of 'union mission'. What is the fundamental mission of a union?
options: Defend the interests of the profession
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The fundamental mission is to defend the interests of the profession.' MIKOU: 'So it's a collective protector.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, the union mission is noble!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU, after discovering union challenges with Dr. YOUSSEF, announces: 'I'm ready to get involved!' YOUSSEF replies:
options: Welcome, every member strengthens the profession
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF, moved: 'Welcome, MIKOU! Every member strengthens the profession.' MIKOU: 'I'm proud to join the team!' YOUSSEF: 'The strength of the union is its members!'
